---
title: "Wisdom of Crowds: Budget Edition"
date: "2009-05-19"
categories: ["Economics", "Fiscal Policy", "Politics"]
---

Only 30% of [Newspoll](http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/files/19may-newspoll.html "Newspoll") respondents believe the federal budget will be back in surplus within six years.  There is a sharp partisan divide on this issue, although surplus skepticism increases with age and income.  It is interesting that the most well received federal budget since 1993 was also the Howard government’s last.
